decoys.evidence: cpp/AGENTS.md, cpp/daal/AGENTS.md, cpp/oneapi/AGENTS.md, examples/AGENTS.md, cpp-coding-guidelines 'Critical Reminders #1' and general.instructions 'What NOT to Generate': NEVER mix DAAL and oneAPI patterns in the same file. Every oneAPI CPU backend is a DAAL bridge: at 3120d0ab 101 files under cpp/oneapi #include DAAL headers, 103 reference daal::, 56 call interop::status_to_exception; this very file already calls interop::call_daal_kernel/status_to_exception three times.

cpp-coding-guidelines 'Naming Conventions': 'Class Members: With underscore suffix: entries_, store_, comm_'. In cpp/daal, member declarations with a leading underscore (_name;) = 865 hits in 218 files vs 6 hits in 3 files with a trailing underscore; covariance_impl.i's own SumsReducer uses _dataTable/_numRowsInBlock/_nFeatures/_sumsArray. (The suffix rule holds in cpp/oneapi: 828 suffix vs 40 prefix.)

cpp-coding-guidelines 'Extensions: Avoid compiler-specific extensions'; general.instructions 'What NOT to Generate: Platform-specific hardcoded code'. cpp/daal uses PRAGMA_OMP_SIMD 275x and PRAGMA_VECTOR_ALWAYS 209x (59 files) as the standard inner-loop idiom; the pair appears verbatim in covariance_impl.i. The macros expand to nothing on compilers that do not support them.

cpp/daal/AGENTS.md 'Memory: Use daal::services::SharedPtr<T>, never raw pointers for ownership'; general.instructions 'Raw pointers for ownership' under What NOT to Generate; root AGENTS.md 'Use smart pointers and RAII'. daal::tls<T*> takes a raw-pointer factory and frees in reduce(): 43 daal::tls< declarations in 29 files, factories such as logistic_regression_predict_dense_default_batch_impl.i:296 and low_order_moments_estimates_batch.i:252 'return new ...', 15 reduce lambdas that 'delete' the TLS pointer; 93 plain delete statements and 0 std::unique_ptr/make_unique uses in cpp/daal/src.

root AGENTS.md 'STL: Leverage standard library containers'; general.instructions 'Smart Pointers: Always use std::unique_ptr and std::shared_ptr' (applyTo '**'). cpp/daal/src uses TArray/TArrayScalable/TArrayCalloc 525x in 115 files and DAAL_CHECK_MALLOC 387x in 107 files, vs std::vector 6 hits in 2 files and 0 std::unique_ptr.

cpp-coding-guidelines 'Naming Conventions': 'Constants: UPPER_CASE: MAX_ITERATIONS' and 'Variables: cluster_count' (snake_case). In cpp/daal/src 'const(expr) size_t <lowerCamel> = ' occurs 838x in 199 files vs 4x UPPER_CASE (3 files); 67 such blockSize-style constants; nRows 1259x vs row_count 0x. Hard-coded row blocks are the norm (e.g. nRowsInBlock = 512 in logistic_regression predict).
